1 corresponding to G.R. Case No.664 of 2022 registered under Sections 341/294/328/376(2)(n)/506 of the IPC pending in the Court of leaned J.M.F.C., Nimapara.
The petitioner had approached the learned Additional Sessions Judge- cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Cuttack praying for grant of bail.
The learned Additional Sessions Judge, Niampara vide its order dated 11.04.2024, rejected the bail application of the petitioner.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C. praying for enlargement on bail.
5. The prosecution case is that the petitioner was working as a caretaker of Debaraj Medicine Store for last four years.
During the said period, the informant used to go the said shop to purchase medicines.
In course of those visits, the petitioner started talking with the informant over telephone.
One day, the informant went to the house of the petitioner to bring medicine, where the petitioner offered some soft drink to the informant and after drinking it, she became unconscious.
Taking advantage, the petitioner kept physical relationship with her.
After regaining her consciousness, she was wanted to lodge complaint.
The petitioner showed the video of him committing sexual intercourse with the informant and threatened to circulate it over the internet.

Showing that threat,
he has been committing sexual intercourse with the informant for four years.
On 10.2.2022, the petitioner asked the informant to go to a hotel and on being denied, he threatened to kill her and circulate the video.

Hence, the F.I.R.
6.
Learned counsel for the State submits that in the meantime, the victim has already been examined as P.W.1 on 11.09.2024.
She has not supported the prosecution case.
She inter alia
stating
as under:
"2. Due to some misunderstanding, I have lodged the F.I.R.

This is the said F.I.R.
marked as Ext.P3 and this is my signature thereon marked as Ext.P3/1.
On the date of occurrence, the police seized one maroon coloured printed saree and one printed blouse on my production and prepared seizure list in my presence.
This is the said seizure list marked as Ext.P4 and this is my signature thereon marked as Ext.P4/1.
This is my signature which I put on a document at the hospital marked as Ext.P5.
Police took me to a Magistrate for recording of my statement.
This is my statement before the Magistrate marked as Ext.P6 and these are my signatures thereon marked as Ext.P6/1 to Ext.P6/5.
I do not know anything more about the facts of the case.
I was examined by police in connection with this case."
7. The prosecutrix is present in Court today along with her counsel and she is identified by her counsel.
She has filed the photocopy of her self attested Adhar Card to establish her identity.
On the query from the Court, she stated that she does not have any objection if the petitioner is enlarged on bail.
8. Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that the plea of bail of the petitioner is not pending before any other Court, except the present one.

9. Taking into consideration the period of custody since 31.03.2024, the nature of accusation and the fact that the prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution case, I am inclined to admit the Dillip Barik vs State Of Odisha ....
